land.purpose: One player at a time starting with the player who has the Sun card, then continuing on in the direction it indicates, play a Land card, face up, orthogonally adjacent to any cards already placed in front of you while respecting the play restriction: creating a 4 by 4 cards square, and watch out for the desolation caused by the Tzimimes!
land.mountain: End of the game: score 1 for each contained in your biggest range (= the group of cards with the most orthogonally adjacent and contiguous).
land.water: If you place this card next to another card, it will immediately be flipped face Tzimimes up. End of the game: For each , score 1 for each orthogonally adjacent card to this . Important: the cards with Tzimimes face up do not score any points.
land.plant: End of the game: For each different animal in your World, score 2 .
land.swamp: If you place this card on a line where another is already present, it will immediately be turned face up. End of the game: For each , score 3 .
land.moon: If you place a card anywhere other than on the top line of your world, it will immediately be flipped face up to Tzimime. End of the game: For each , score 2 for each icon on the card adjacent below and each occurrence of these icons in the column. If below a , you have a Fumarole or a Tzimime face up, you score 0 .
land.volcano:
As soon as you place a card featuring a Volcano <volcano />, place a Fumarole card on a card adjacent to that Volcano <volcano />, including on a Tzimimes card.

A Fumerole card can never cover another Fumerole card.

If the Volcano's <volcano /> placement does not allow a Fumarole card to be placed, this card will immediately be turned face up Tzimime.
land.fumarole:
A Fumarole card is played after a <volcano /> card has been played.

A Fumarole card must necessarily be placed on a card adjacent to the last <volcano /> card played, including on a face-down card (Tzimimes visible), but a Fumarole card can never cover another Fumarole card.

If you can't place a Fumarole card, the associated <volcano /> card will be turned face up Tzimine.

Fumarole cards don't earn you any points at the end of the game, but they do contribute to the creation of Dark Cities.
card.tzimime.text:
Tzimines appear when an anomaly is created in your world.

They are a hole in your world and do not score points at the end of the game.

However, they can be covered by a fumarole card.

<bold>Please note: Tzimime desolation applies BEFORE the creation of a Portal or the effect of a</bold> <volcano />.

Once drafted, this card will join your hand.
card.deck.text: This card is in the deck. There are {cards, plural, one{# card} other{# cards}} left in the deck.
card.first-player: First player card and drafting direction
traveler.1.text: +5 <star /> if there are at least 3 <water /> in the 2 rows concerned.
traveler.2.text: +4 <star /> if there is 1 <swamp /> in each of the rows concerned.
traveler.3.text: +6 <star /> if there are at least 5 <mountain /> in the 2 rows concerned.
traveler.4.text: +8 <star /> if there are at least 2 <plant />, 2 <water />, 2 <mountain /> and 2 <swamp /> in the 2 rows concerned.
traveler.5.text: +5 <star /> if there are at least 3 Fumarole cards in the 2 rows concerned.
traveler.6.text: +8 <star /> if there are at least 2 dimensional portals in the 2 rows concerned.
traveler.7.text: +4 <star /> if there is are least 4 different animals ? différents in the 2 rows concerned.
traveler.8.text: +6 <star /> if there are at least 3 <volcano /> in the 2 rows concerned.
dark-city.text:
If you place a Fumarole card adjacent to another Fumarole card, immediately place the available Dark City card with the highest <star /> value at the junction of these 2 Fumarole cards.

If there are no more Dark Cities available, you can't create any more.

This Dark City will earn you {star} <star/> at the end of the game.

<italic>A Fumarole card cannot be part of the creation of several Dark Cities.</italic>
warn.portal: A card that has been involved in the creation of a Dimensional Portal cannot be involved in the creation of a second one.
warn.water: You cannot place a <water/> card next to another <water/> card.
warn.swamp: You cannot place a <swamp/> card next in a row that already has a <swamp/> card.
warn.moon: The <moon/> cards can only be placed in the first row of your World.
warn.tzimime: Your card has automatically been placed face down on Tzimime, which earns no points.
tuto.welcome: Welcome to the <bold>Strange World above the clouds</bold> tutorial!
tuto.panorama: In this game, each player creates a World made up of 16 cards (a 4 x 4 square) in front of them, with the aim of obtaining the most Stars: <star/>.
tuto.starting:
Here's your <bold>Starting Land</bold> card.
The game is played in <bold>5 turns</bold>, and each turn you'll add <bold>3 Land cards</bold> to your World.
tuto.green: Here are the <bold>Land cards</bold> you have in your hand. Each player draws <bold>3 Land cards</bold> at the start of their turn.
tuto.one: You can only keep one of these 3 cards. Each turn, you must give 2 cards to one of your opponents, Florian or Céline.
tuto.draft.sun:
The <bold>Sun card</bold> here determines who you pass your cards to. 
On this turn, you must pass 2 cards to Florian.
tuto.received.r1.2: At the same time, each player passes 2 cards to their left-hand neighbor. You received these 2 cards from Céline.
tuto.draft.r1.1: You must now pass 1 card to Florian. Pass him this one.
tuto.received.r1.1: Simultaneously, each player passes 1 card to his left-hand neighbor. You received this card from Céline.
tuto.hand: The <bold>Draft</bold> is now over, and each player has in hand <bold>the 3 Land cards he will play in his World</bold> this turn.
tuto.sun: Céline has the <bold>Sun card</bold>, now she plays her first card.
tuto.place:
Now it's your turn. You must <bold>place one of your cards in your World</bold>, adjacent to a card already placed.
Place this card there.
tuto.mountain.score:
Your starting Land card has this symbol: <mountain/>.
At the end of the game, you score 1 <star/> per <mountain/> contained in your largest <mountain/> massif.
tuto.mountain.score.2: So you'll have at least 2 <star/> for your <mountain/> thanks to the card you've just added!
tuto.water.score: The card you've just added also has a <water/> symbol: at the end of the game you earn 1 <star/> per Land card next to this card.
tuto.water.warning:
<bold>But beware:</bold> you can't place a <water/> card next to another <water/> card!
If you do, the card you place will be turned face <bold>Tzimime Desolation</bold> up. It won't earn any points - it's a hole in your World!
tuto.opponent.play: It's up to your opponents to play a card in their World.
tuto.play: It's up to you. Place this card here.
tuto.animal.score: The card you have just placed has an Animal. At the end of the game, you earn 2 <star/> for each <bold>different</bold> animal in your World.
tuto.play.last: It's up to you to play your last card. Place it here.
tuto.swamp.score: This card has a <swamp/> symbol: it yields 3 <star/> at the end of the game, <bold>but be careful, you can't put 2 in the same row!</bold>
tuto.portal:
By laying down these 2 cards, you have assembled a <bold>Dimensional Portal</bold>!
It allows you to choose a <bold>Traveler card</bold> still available and add it to the end of the line.
tuto.traveler:
Each <bold>Traveler card</bold> earns points at the end of the game under different conditions.
At any time, you can <bold>click on a card to find out its effect</bold>.
tuto.traveler.choose: Choose this Traveller and place it here.
tuto.traveler.placement:
The Traveller is positioned at the end of the line, on the right or left, and overlapping 2 lines.
This Traveler will earn you 5 <star/> at the end of the game and <bold>+6 <star/> if you have at least 5</bold> <mountain/> <bold>in the 2 lines he overlaps</bold>.
tuto.traveler.world: What's more, a traveler <bold>limits a side</bold> of your World: your 4 x 4 square will therefore have to be made by adding cards to the right now.
tuto.opponent.play.2: Florian now places his last card, and the 2nd round begins.
tuto.round.2:
This is the start of the 2nd round (a game is played in 5 rounds).
In this round, you hold the sun card: you choose which way to deal the cards.
Choose to give your cards to Céline, for a change.
tuto.draft.r2.2:
Each player is dealt 3 cards, as in the first round.
Give these 2 cards to Céline and keep the 3rd for yourself.
tuto.draft.r2.1: Now give this card to Céline and keep the other 2.
tuto.play.2: Place this card here, in your World.
tuto.moon.score:
A <moon/> card earns 2 <star/> for each symbol in the column that are identical to those placed just below the Moon card.
If a fumarole or a Tzimimes face-up card is just below it, your Moon yields no points.
tuto.moon.score.2:
Here, it already yields 6 <star/>: 4 for the 2 <mountain/>, and 2 for the <water/>.
You can try adding <mountain/> or <water/> symbols to the column to score more <star/>!
tuto.moon.warning:
<bold/>Beware</bold>: a <moon/> card can only exist in the first row of your World.
If a <moon/> card is found in one of the other 3 rows, it will immediately be turned face-down and earn no points!
tuto.volcano:
There's a <bold>Volcano</bold> on the card you've just placed.
When you place a Volcano, you must place a <bold>Fumarole</bold> card on an adjacent card.
tuto.fumarole.cover: The card that has disappeared under the Fumarole is worth no points at the end of the game.
tuto.fumarole.warning: <bold>Beware</bold>: a Fumarole card cannot cover another Fumarole card. If a Volcano cannot emit its Fumarole, it will be turned face down.
tuto.fumarole.play.2: Place the Fumarole of this new Volcano here.
tuto.fumarole.dark-city: When you place a Fumarole card adjacent to another Fumarole card, you immediately place the highest-value available <bold>Dark City</bold> card at the junction of the 2 Fumaroles.
tuto.dark-city.score:
This Dark City will earn you 9 <star/> at the end of the game.
<italic>A Fumarole card cannot participate in the creation of several Dark Cities.</italic>
tuto.end.trigger:
The game continues in this way until each player has completed his World of 4 x 4 cards.
The player whose World is worth the most <star/> wins the game!
tuto.reminder:
Don't forget: at any time, <bold>you can click on a card to find out what it's doing</bold>.
Now it's your turn, good luck and watch out for the Tzimimes!
